_guide: Links used across the website. Change only the text between the quotes on the right.
An empty value ("") hides everything that needs that link; fill it in and the next build shows it.
Every link must start with https:// (or mailto: for an e-mail address).
steam: the Steam store page. Shows the Wishlist buttons, the Steam icon and the contract offer section.
trailer: the trailer on YouTube. Shows the trailer block and the 'Watch the trailer' links.
press_kit: the press kit (a page or a ZIP). press_key: where journalists request a key, e.g. mailto:press@coalharbour.games.
contact: the contact form on the studio website. studio: the studio website.
socials: the list under 'Follow the company', in this order. Add or remove whole { "name": ..., "url": ... } lines.
